race.comment: Siding with the resuming CASTELLITO (7) who was a smart winner first up last time in at Kyneton at $1.40, heavily supported in a good race at Bendigo when failing next time out. Clearly she's had a couple issues but she's got ability and can take beating here. EENY MEENY (1) has shown good ability in two runs to date, winning on debut at Sale over a subsequent winner before in Laura Eliza. He was good again in Adelaide and looks hard to catch here. LOGAM (4) was poor at Sandown Hillside last time but had been racing well prior and can bounce back. FROSTED IN TIME (3) wasn't beaten far behind an in-form horse fresh here and should be right there from a good draw. TAN TAT ART (10) should be thereabouts again.
